title: Todo list v2
description: A second todo reference app used to test LLP 0021 and LLP 0051 D6: a richer row shape, an all-IR generated Contract binding surface, retained/offline replay, Exact project checks, a wrong-native-server-shape capability diagnostic, and an Exact-owned provider conformance fixture.

backend.stalenessPolicy: committed; regenerate with codegen; freshness tracked by artifacts.json inputsHash

headless.toolchain: node>=22 (built-in fetch); cargo to build/run the local server

registerBoot.toolchain: node>=22 (built-in fetch + WebSocket); cargo to build/run the local server
registerBoot.note: LLP 0090 D4 rollout step 7 (ENG-25458): Channel C authenticated web boot — shell + one register-mode POST /app/bundle; the surface adopts the bundle registrations (rqsRegistered seam), the socket attaches under the bundle grant, and the wire shows exactly one snapshot per query (the bundle's). The browser surface (main.ts) performs the same boot; this suite is its wire-instrumented proof.

contract.browserRunner: bun install --cwd demos/todo-v2/surfaces/contract (once), then SNAPBACK_TODO_V2_API=http://127.0.0.1:4421 bun run --cwd demos/todo-v2/surfaces/contract dev (Exact consumed from the npm registry; the surface bun.lock is the pin - ENG-22480 model, migrated by ENG-23899)
contract.build: bun run --cwd demos/todo-v2/surfaces/contract build (vite build via the exactContractWeb preset -> surfaces/contract/dist/web/)

exact.resolver: demos/_kit/exact-resolver.mjs (installed locked packages by default; SNAPBACK_EXACT_ROOT or .snapback/local.json is an explicit checkout override)
exact.toolchain: bun (to load Exact package exports from an install or local checkout)

react.note: Historical scoping (2026-Q1, snapback.v0): this demo predates the React/Expo adapter and deliberately ships no React surface. The first-party adapter has since shipped — see guide/capabilities.md (clients.react, clients.react-expo) and packages/snapback-cli/templates/react; the headless SnapbackClient remains the framework-neutral core it binds over.

headless: create/toggle/priority/delete mutations with server-owned system fields
realtime update reaches a second client
wrong native Exact server shape diagnostic (SNAPBACK_CAPABILITY_EXACT_NATIVE_ARTIFACT_MISSING)
contract: Exact project checks validate generated descriptor modules and row shapes
adapter rejected-mutation rollback republishes authoritative rows
adapter exposes one combined pending mutation count across runtime links and provider mutations
contract bindings resolve to generated Snapback descriptors
mounts against live backend; renders live snapshot
Contract action drives a Snapback mutation (optimistic update)
Contract actions toggle completion, change priority, and delete through Snapback mutations
mutation is server-authoritative and visible to headless surface (cross-surface)
provider seam subscribe + mutate on live backend
Exact-owned DataProvider conformance suite passes against the Snapback provider
runtime links include the generated setPriority mutation
retained authorized rows and queued create/toggle/delete survive reload
reconnect full-resyncs, replays by monotonic sequence, and applies each mutation exactly once
no demo-local Contract sidecars are required

capabilityGaps: ibex_ctx_db_host_bridge (JS ctx.db handlers; v0 uses declarative HostPlans)
capabilityGapsNote: Frozen at demo-scoping time (2026-Q1, snapback.v0): entries record what this demo does not exercise, not current platform capability. Several have since shipped or partially shipped — react_adapter (clients.react shipped), assets (backend.assets partial), cron (backend.cron shipped), notifications (backend.expo-push-seam shipped; first-class backend.notifications remains a GAP), external_auth (auth.external-identity-broker partial). guide/capabilities.md is the current capability truth.
notClaiming: arbitrary JS handler replay, mixed-tier/multi-query offline parity, and delta-resume with pending writes
Partiful-scale throughput (this is a demo shape, not a benchmark)
JS handler execution (HostPlan declarative plans only in v0)
